answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports the objective because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 links conversion to pipeline quality, though it omits realized revenue and durability. Memories 31 and 86 show durable activation or adoption improvements but do not establish downstream qualified revenue or retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits discount effects on margins, retention, and long-term customer quality. Memory 91 only demonstrates near-term engagement and meaningful-action gains, with no stated revenue, qualification, retention, or durability evidence.
